_source: Deterministic parse of raw Cloop CSV exports (Real Time Metrics Report, two Historical Metrics Reports — queue-level and agent-level) via scripts/parse_cloop.py, chained against assets/data/reports/2026-10-29/cloop.json. The historical files cover 2026-10-30 (Friday) rather than the simple 'yesterday' — the Real-Time extraction landed on Monday 2026-11-02, so per the weekend-rollback rule the historical business day is the preceding Friday, not Sunday 2026-11-01. totalCasesToDate/inProgressTenDayTrend/openCasesTenDayTrend are NOT derivable from these CSVs at all (no raw source for them exists); the user supplied them directly by hand (10861 / 146 / 55) rather than from a source PDF — see _totalCasesToDateNote.
_extractedAtNote: No exact extraction time was available — the Real-Time CSV carries no timestamp of its own, and this file wasn't fetched via SharePoint (no lastModifiedDateTime to read). Time is inferred from the two Historical CSVs' own embedded generation timestamps (05:32:53 queue-level and 05:32:03 agent-level, Malaysia local time on 2026-11-02, converted +3 hours for the AEDT offset in effect — 08:32:53 and 08:32:03 Canberra time), on the assumption all three files were pulled in the same batch. The Real-Time snapshot being taken the next business morning after the date it reports on means Monday 2 Nov here (skipping the Oct 31-Nov 1 weekend), same pattern as every other date.
_realTimeQueuesNote: Real-time snapshot as of the extraction above (2026-11-02 morning) — 5 queues, Summary row 44 in queue / oldest 137:46:43 (5.74 days).
_note: contactsQueuedYesterday sums to 107 exactly, matching this file's own contactsQueuedTenDayTrend position 9 (labelled 'Fri 30-Oct', the historical date these two Historical CSVs cover) and chain-matching 2026-10-29's own committed trend exactly at positions 0-8.
_emailsHandledNote: 8 agents, summing to 132 total (62 incoming-heavy via Chloey Leow, the rest low-volume). No reconciliation issues found against any other figure in this file (there is no separate printed total to check against, unlike a PDF-sourced date).
_totalCasesToDateNote: Not derived from any CSV or PDF this run — the user supplied these three numbers directly (10861 / 146 / 55), stated as current as of today. Filed under this report's own date (2026-10-30) per the usual convention, as position 9 of a trend whose label ('Mon 2-Nov') reflects the next-business-morning snapshot timing every prior date has also used for this same chart (skipping the Oct 31-Nov 1 weekend). Positions 0-8 chain-match 2026-10-29's own committed trend exactly for both trends. totalOverallCases (10861) is a +84 increase over 2026-10-29's committed 10777.
